milestones.title: Foundations
milestones.outcome: The ArcForges repository builds and tests in hosted CI; the flagship contracts and the two DesktopPlatform adaptations are published; implementation repositories point at the new design.

milestones.title: First managed run on Windows
milestones.outcome: A user runs `arcforges run -- <command>` on Windows: submitted once, persisted, executed in a job object, output and exit code returned, and it survives a node restart.

milestones.title: Linux execution
milestones.outcome: The same works on Linux and WSL2 through transient systemd units, with durable exit records and survival across node restarts.

milestones.title: Resource control
milestones.outcome: Many tasks run in parallel under computed budgets with pools, priorities, a parallelism policy and pressure handling; the Windows host and a WSL guest share one fair queue without double counting; origins, permissions and approvals apply.

milestones.title: Records and diagnosis
milestones.outcome: Users see where time went, findings with evidence and remedies, and learned estimates feed admission.

milestones.title: Toolchains and caches
milestones.outcome: .NET, Rust, C/C++ (including FASTBuild), Node and Python work uses shared managed caches, with tool concurrency tied to grants.

milestones.title: Storage and workspaces
milestones.outcome: Disk usage is analyzed and reclaimed safely, and agents get managed worktrees.

milestones.title: AI integration
milestones.outcome: Claude Code and Codex run work through ArcForges (MCP, hooks, routing) with honest coverage.

milestones.title: Desktop
milestones.outcome: The Desktop app shows and controls all local features.

milestones.title: Distribution
milestones.outcome: Users download, install, update and roll back signed artifacts from arcforges.com.

milestones.title: Cloud platform, account and entitlements
milestones.outcome: The cloud platform services and account authentication exist; nodes sign in through the browser or a device code, entitlements are enforced offline, and support bundles reach cases.

milestones.title: LAN
milestones.outcome: Paired machines on a LAN share work and compiler caches.

milestones.title: Remote access
milestones.outcome: Pro users watch and control nodes from the web, and receive push notifications.

milestones.title: Commerce and Android
milestones.outcome: Users subscribe on the web (Paddle) or in Google Play, and use the Android app.

milestones.title: Operations and release candidate
milestones.outcome: Operators run the service within budgets, every journey passes in closed loop, and the acceptance register is ready for the user.
